description: A selfie at an outdoor music festival at sunset. Two young women press their cheeks together and laugh with wide open mouths: one with long braids in a blue crop top, the other with curly hair in a yellow halter top. Colourful confetti swirls in the sky, the stage behind glows with coloured lights, and the crowd dances around them, one young man sitting on a friend's shoulders with his fist up, and a straw hat flies into the air. The sky is streaked pink and orange.
